n2dade67cb2.headline: Governor of the BCT: Fitch’s ‘C’ threatens us if we do not do what is necessary
n2dade67cb2.summary: Tunisia’s central bank governor stated that Fitch may downgrade the country’s credit rating if necessary reforms are not implemented within two months.
n2dade67cb2.why: Credit rating downgrades can increase borrowing costs and reduce investor confidence, impacting Tunisia’s economic stability and access to international capital.
